text:
Priya (CS Lead): Hey all — drafting an outbound status + RCA timeline for impacted onboarders. Sharing below, need edits + who can own sending?

Priya (CS Lead): DRAFT customer note:
```
Hi <CustomerTeam>,

We wanted to update you about the onboarding interruptions you experienced between Mar 18 09:15–11:40 UTC. Root cause: cascading retry storm after a malformed retry policy caused queue saturation on our dedicated onboarding workers.

Mitigation we applied: we rolled back the new retry policy at 11:42 UTC, increased worker pool by 20% for affected queues, and enabled a short-lived throttling rule to prevent retries from amplifying. Service normalized by 11:50 UTC.

Next steps:
- Full RCA will be shared by Mar 22 COB.
- Affected accounts will receive a 10% billing credit for the onboarding month and a dedicated enablement session to catch up on backlog (we propose a 60-min session w/ Solutions + CSM).
- We are adding a pre-deploy validation to prevent invalid retry configs and expanding observability on queue saturation.

If you want to schedule a catch-up call, please reply with your availability. Apologies for the disruption — we know this impacts your ramp.

— Priya on behalf of Redwood Inference
```

Liam (Solutions): Suggest changing the credit wording to "one-time onboarding credit" and specify estimated $ amount range? Customers ask for numbers. Also add a line offering priority scheduling for the enablement session.

Maya (CSM): +1 on the priority language. For renewals-risked customers, we should proactively offer a 1:1 sync and propose three time slots. I can draft the outreach for those accounts.

Evan (Support): FYI we already queued affected tickets and flagged them as "onboarding-backlog-urgent". ETA to clear backlog per account varies; I'll attach per-account estimates before outbound.

Jordan (Product): Action items on our side: add a validation guard in the deployment pipeline (PR 3941), and create an alert when retry rate > 15% sustained for 2 minutes. We'll include the mitigation plan in the RCA.

Priya (CS Lead): Good. For credits: proposing "10% onboarding-month credit (up to $1,000)" — agree?

Liam (Solutions): That cap sounds reasonable. For enterprise customers we can increase case-by-case — flag Jordan to allow escrow approval if needed.

Maya (CSM): I'll prepare two templates: one for standard impacted customers and one escalation template for renewal-risked accounts. I'll also capture brief feedback questions to include in the outreach (2 quick items).

Priya (CS Lead): Please add the quick feedback capture — we want to measure impact and if this influenced renewal sentiment. Suggested survey snippet:
- How did this incident affect your onboarding timeline? (short)
- How satisfied are you with Redwood's response? (1–5)

Evan (Support): Also include an "Are you interested in a priority support line for migration/onboarding?" checkbox so CS can route follow-ups.

Jordan (Product): I'll timeline the RCA for Mar 22 COB and include PR links + commit hashes. Also will attach the post-mortem runbook updates.

Priya (CS Lead): Who can send the first batch to the impacted mid-market customers (approx 40 accounts) later today? I can send to high-priority renewal-risked accounts after Maya's templates.

Maya (CSM): I can send the 40 mid-market batch at 16:00 PT if Evan shares per-account backlog ETAs by 15:30.

Evan (Support): Will deliver the ETAs by 15:10.

Liam (Solutions): I'll coordinate the enablement session scheduling and create a shared calendar with proposed slots.

Priya (CS Lead): Great. Quick checklist before send: 
- [ ] Finalize credit wording (Priya)
- [ ] Per-account backlog ETA (Evan)
- [ ] Two outreach templates (Maya)
- [ ] RCA timeline note (Jordan)
- [ ] Schedule for enablement (Liam)

Priya (CS Lead): When outbound goes live, please react to this thread with :thumbsup: and paste the list of accounts sent.

incident-bot: Incident #2026-03-18-ONB: status changed to "mitigated" at 11:50 UTC — RCA ETA: 2026-03-22 23:59 UTC.

Maya (CSM): Quick nuance for messaging to renewals-risked cohort: add an explicit sentence: "We understand timing matters for your launch — if this affects upcoming milestones that impact renewals, let us know and we'll prioritize handoffs and credits."

Priya (CS Lead): Good call. I'll incorporate and send the mid-market batch. Sending now — will paste account list in thread in 5m. :rocket:

Maya (CSM): Received — prepping escalation templates.

Evan (Support): ETAs uploaded to the shared sheet: https://redwood.internal/sheets/onboarding-backlog-ETAs (internal).

Liam (Solutions): Calendar created: https://calendar.redwood/invite/onboard-makeup (internal).

Priya (CS Lead): Sent to 40 accounts at 16:12 PT. Pasted list below. :heavy_check_mark:
- acme-inc
- beta-systems
- clearpath-ai
- datafold-labs
- epoch-ml
- ... (full list uploaded to the shared drive)

Maya (CSM): Noted. I'll follow up with the renewal-risked cohort in a separate message.

Priya (CS Lead): Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after the RCA is published and after the first round of enablement sessions complete to review renewal risk signals and any upsell/retention actions.

Liam (Solutions): :thumbsup:

Jordan (Product): Adding the post-deploy validation to the triage board.

Evan (Support): Closing support incident tags once backlog per-account is <= 2 items.

Priya (CS Lead): End of thread — will attach the final outbound copy + RCA link once available.
